info.name: Stayo - Unified Collection (Members 1-3 consolidated by Member 4)
info.description:
Consolidated Postman collection for the Stayo Hotel/Property Management & Reservation System.

Built by merging:
- Member 1: Auth, Hotels, Rooms, Availability Search
- Member 2: Pricing Rules, Bookings (API contract)
- Member 3: Bookings implementation (bookingController.js) used to derive expected status codes / error codes

Run order matters - see 'Test execution order' in the README. Folders are numbered to enforce a safe run order in the Collection Runner.
